ordinary.description: Ordinary Python with NumPy, pandas, SciPy and StatsForecast; no Gnomon import.
ordinary.tool_contract: One Python tool in the isolated software image. Local files persist within a task.
ordinary.guidance: Choose any available tool. Submit only your own supported answer; preserve earlier commitments.

lean.description: The same ordinary software plus current Gnomon execution tools, optional ledger and temporal operations enabled.
lean.tool_contract: Python plus persistent execution-profile MCP in a separate container; no agent outcome-write permission.
lean.guidance: Choose any available tool. Submit only your own supported answer; preserve earlier commitments.

full.description: The same ordinary software and execution session, with optional ledger and temporal tools enabled.
full.tool_contract: Python plus persistent execution MCP in a separate container; same provider contract as lean, with ledger and temporal discovery enabled at startup.
full.guidance: Choose any available tool. Submit only your own supported answer; preserve earlier commitments.
